description: Canonical set of GitHub Actions secrets.* references used by LaxClaws workflows. Contract test asserts set equality against every secrets.NAME in .github/workflows/*.yml (GITHUB_TOKEN excluded — platform-provided).

secrets.name: ACTIVITY_PIPELINE_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Activity wire auth for Phase C fixture redeploy (CLAWS_ACTIVITY_SECRET)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); must match Vercel ACTIVITY_PIPELINE_SECRET (preview+production)

secrets.name: CLEANUP_DATABASE_URL_PRODUCTION
secrets.purpose: Read-only Neon pooled URL for production OpenClawVersion / GHCR cleanup inventory
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); Neon production branch connection string

secrets.name: CLEANUP_DATABASE_URL_STAGING
secrets.purpose: Read-only Neon pooled URL for staging OpenClawVersion / GHCR cleanup inventory
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); Neon staging branch connection string

secrets.name: GHCR_DELETE_PAT
secrets.purpose: PAT with delete:packages for live GHCR cleanup only (not required for dry-run)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); create only when enabling live cleanup

secrets.name: GHCR_READ_PAT
secrets.purpose: PAT with read:packages to resolve GHCR digests for openclaw-runtime
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); pairs with vars.GHCR_READ_USER

secrets.name: OPS_ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY
secrets.purpose: Staging ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY for ops Phase C redeploy (decrypt UserApiKey)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); must match staging Vercel ENCRYPTION_MASTER_KEY

secrets.name: OPS_STAGING_DATABASE_URL
secrets.purpose: Write-capable Neon URL for ops Phase C fixture redeploy (not CLEANUP read-only)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); must match staging Vercel DATABASE_URL / .env.staging

secrets.name: PROD_METERING_MASTER_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Prod METERING_MASTER_SECRET value for probe-4 upload auth (X-Metering-Secret)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); must match Vercel production METERING_MASTER_SECRET — name confirmed operator 2026-07-14

secrets.name: RAILWAY_STAGING_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Railway API token for Claws Staging project deploys (Phase C ops redeploy)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); Railway account token with staging (+ optionally prod) project access

secrets.name: STAGING_CRON_SECRET
secrets.purpose: Bearer token for staging-cron-scheduler.yml curls of staging /api/cron/* routes
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); must match staging Vercel env CRON_SECRET (Vercel → staging.app.buildclaws.ai → Environment Variables)

secrets.name: TEST_DATABASE_URL
secrets.purpose: Neon pooled URL for CI unit/integration and e2e keepalive
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); CI test Neon project

secrets.name: TEST_DIRECT_URL
secrets.purpose: Neon direct (non-pooler) URL for Prisma migrate in CI
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); same CI Neon project, direct host

secrets.name: VERCEL_PROJECT_ID
secrets.purpose: Vercel project id for polling Production READY during platform promote
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); Vercel project settings

secrets.name: VERCEL_TEAM_ID
secrets.purpose: Optional Vercel team scope for deployment listing
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); Laxcorp Research Vercel team

secrets.name: VERCEL_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Vercel API token for Production deploy READY poll
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); Vercel account token

secrets.name: SANDBOX_ANTHROPIC_KEY
secrets.purpose: Dedicated low-limit Anthropic key for marketplace skill sandbox agent turn (do NOT reuse CLAWS_MASTER_ANTHROPIC_KEY or BYOK)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); restricted Anthropic key; never reuse platform master

secrets.name: SANDBOX_REPORT_TOKEN
secrets.purpose: Auth for sandbox job fetch + report intake (X-Sandbox-Report-Token)
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); must match Vercel SANDBOX_REPORT_TOKEN (Preview + Production)

secrets.name: VERSION_PIPELINE_SECRET
secrets.whereCreated: Repo Actions secret (ops); must match VERSION_PIPELINE_SECRET on staging and prod Vercel
